verses.author: model_A
verses.text: An orchard planted by a man who never tasted its fruit.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone bit into it this morning
juice on their chin, not knowing whose hands
dug the first hole for roots

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the ladder still leans
against a branch he never reached—
morning light climbs it alone

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a bird lands where his hand once was
shakes the leaves loose
and doesn't wait to see them fall

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the orchard keeps no debts
each spring pays itself forward
in blossoms no one owns

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone else will find this shade at noon
not knowing whose sweat dug the well
just drinks, and walks on cooler

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the path forgets whose feet wore it smooth
only the smoothness stays
inviting the next stranger's steps

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
my shadow falls where his once did
the fence doesn't ask whose hand it was
it just leans, still standing

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a stone thins where thumbs have rubbed it
worn for luck, not for us --
we pass the shine along, unnamed

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the cup waits at the spring's mouth
no one carved their name in its rim
it fills again for whoever kneels

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a bell keeps no memory of the hands that rang it
only the sound leaving
again, again, into other ears

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the path doesn't remember my footsteps either
only that grass gave way once
and is learning to stand again

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the wind takes the bell's last note somewhere
I won't follow to see where it settles
just glad it had somewhere to go

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a stranger's cup left by the cup I used
still warm where my hand was
so easy to mistake for staying

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the river carries the leaf far past the branch
that never asked it back
just watched the water go on shining

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I sweep the porch and find the broom worn thin
years of dust that never once complained
happy just to leave with the wind
